title: the clearance gate berths in CodeMother and answers queueme; the harbor answers no clear
intention: The clearance gate is CodeMother's machine: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py moves whole to cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/clearance.py, with its seven proofs, the harbor's probe-report proof, its four probes and its deprecation report. It answers machines/clearance/queueme <fileref>: it instantiates the ticket from the fileref, derives the crossing (the next step, the proofs that declare the ticket, the owning component's journal) and asks clearance.clear as codemother; a grant crosses the ticket through Ticket.passed, a refusal comes back as data. The harbor answers show, get and crossing and no clear; CodeMother answers no cross verb; `cairn codemother cross <ticket>` has the ticket queue itself at clearance.
why: Outline 9.4.1.5 (Akien 2026-11-10, Q#80): the harbor's verbs are status queries (show, get) and crossing; it answers no gate and moves no ticket; clear leaves. Outline 9.6 and 3.3.4.3 (Q#81): the gates are CodeMother's machines. RULE 1: once clearance is CodeMother's the harbor may not import it, so clear leaves the harbor in the same act.
traces_to: outline 3.3.4.3, 9.4.1.5, 9.6, 9.7; ticket 386ea8131006 (the watchme receiver moved the same way).
how: git mv module, proofs, probes; old validations leave through bin/cairn artifact remove and the proofs reseal at the new address; build ClearanceGate beside the module (modelled on the watchme gate) and register it in declared_machines; Ticket.passed takes the gate's door as its cross callable so clearance does the one emit; delete HarborMasterDevice._handle_clear and CodeMotherDevice._handle_cross; _handle_sealed queues each named boat at the gate; the cross mouth calls Ticket.queueme; repoint every importer and every text spelling; forward every moved path on this ticket's state.

no class-space file outside history, state, validations and journals names the old module, its probes or its moved proofs in any spelling (dotted, slash, path-joined)

CodeMotherDevice declares no 'cross' verb and its declared_machines holds 'clearance'; a ClearanceGate over a scratch world, asked machines/clearance/queueme {fileref} for a ticket at TICKETME, derives target BUILDME and proven_by from the scratch proof whose PROVES names the ticket, and answers accepted False with a refusal naming a clearance exception class and door 'clearance', leaving the ticket's cursor where it stood
encapsulation_breaches('.') holds no breach between codemother and harbor_master that names clearance, and its total is not above 71
tickets 0354c0269ff7, 0cde908b8fbe, 2b16d2d8b056 and faa51bcfbdfc carry a watchme.probe that resolves to a file under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/probes/
python3 -m cairn.devices.codemother.machines.clearance <the harbor charter> exits 0 and prints DEPRECATION REPORT
Ticket.passed given a cross callable crosses through it exactly once and never through transitions.emit, then writes the cursor it returned
cairn/devices/codemother/0/bin/cross takes one positional (the ticket), sends no verb 'cross', and has the ticket queue itself at clearance through Ticket.queueme

decisions.text: D1: git mv cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py to cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/clearance.py WHOLE, riders block included; add __init__.py, gate.py (ClearanceGate) and __main__.py (the deprecation report moved from register._retirement_report, run as python3 -m cairn.devices.codemother.machines.clearance <intention>). Write the new charter intention+why.json through bin/cairn artifact write before BUILDME (modelled on machines/watchme's). Amend the harbor charter's what and invoke to say the gate is CodeMother's; add clearance to codemother's held_machines and its why.

D2: git mv the seven clearance proofs (test_clearance, test_clearance_accepts_a_recorded_approval, test_clearance_reaches_trouble_through_its_tool, test_clearance_reads_a_plan_approval, test_a_notified_file_is_covered, test_harbor_asks_the_real_host renamed test_clearance_asks_the_real_host, test_the_proven_space_rule_follows_the_ticket_kind) and test_harbor_master_probes_report_to_the_watch (renamed test_clearance_probes_report_to_the_watch, BERTH retargeted to clearance/probes/) to cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/; their old validations leave through bin/cairn artifact remove and each reseals at the new address.

D3: git mv the four probes (a_second_hand_meets_the_gate, a_superseded_intention_is_never_silent, boat_owner_comes_from_the_boat, clearance_actually_gates) and probes/__init__.py to cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/probes/; tickets 0354c0269ff7, 0cde908b8fbe, 2b16d2d8b056, faa51bcfbdfc get watchme.probe rewritten through ticket_file.write_state(plan, state, verb='cast', why='0be964512fb0: the clearance probes berth with the gate').

D4: HarborMasterDevice: delete _handle_clear and the 'clear' entry in declared_verbs; the module docstring stops naming clearance. register.py drops _retirement_report and its import of riders_of; _main given an argument prints that the report is python3 -m cairn.devices.codemother.machines.clearance and exits 2.

D5: ClearanceGate(participant=, roots=) in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/gate.py, declared_verbs {'queueme': self.queueme}, registered in CodeMotherDevice.declared_machines as 'clearance'. queueme reads body.fileref only; Ticket.at(fileref) on the gate's side; target = the workflow path's next step after the cursor; proven_by = proven_by_since_buildme when the target is PROVED, else every proofs/*.py under the repo whose PROVES names the ticket (proof_coverage.declared); history/state = the owning_intention's directory. The actor is codemother (the holder), and the envelope's sender rides as asked_by. A grant calls Ticket.passed(target, cross=partial(clearance.clear, boat_id, proven_by)); an Exception answers {accepted False, refusal: type name, reason}; both carry door 'clearance'. Ticket.passed gains cross=None (default transitions.emit). CodeMotherDevice loses the 'cross' verb, _handle_cross and _crossing_coordinates; _handle_sealed asks the gate for each boat at PROVEME its proof was named on. The mouth bin/cross takes <ticket> and calls Ticket.at(ticket).queueme('clearance', participant=Voice(reach(...), sender='cairn-codemother-cli')). Outline 9.6's verb list drops cross, as its own sentence says.

D6: repoint every importer and text spelling: cairn/devices/cc/scripts/cross.py (import line only; T5 retires it), cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_ticket_is_three_files.py, cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_system_word.py, cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_seal_announces_itself.py, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_hand_kick_back_writes_the_fixme_list.py, cairn/machines/exemptions/probes/every_exemption_cites_a_ruling_or_an_impossibility.py, cairn/tools/base/cross.py, cairn/tools/base/transitions.py, the charters naming the old path (bin, aider_shim, inference_domain, system_rackmount, tools/base, dataref, proof_coverage, system_word, press_office, skills/chart) and press_office/FactSheet.md; test_codemother's cross teeth stop wiring a harbor and read door 'clearance'.

D7: test_clearance's partition tooth stops importing the harbor register (a new codemother->harbor_master breach); it reads open status through the operator_inbox tool's own readers that the register composes, and its retirement-report tooth runs clearance's __main__.

D8: after the move, this ticket's state.json gets a forwarding order {old path: {to: new path, why}} for the module, every moved proof, validation and probe, written through ticket_file.write_state (precedent 164da559823d).

D9: red-first proofs, one tooth per falsifier clause. cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance_berths_in_codemother.py holds clauses 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7; clause 3 stands at the harbor's own address, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_the_harbor_answers_no_clear.py, because a CodeMother proof may not import the harbor (RULE 1; measured: importing it raised encapsulation_breaches to 72). The retired spellings are built split inside the CodeMother proof so it never names them whole; tooth 4 sets CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT to a scratch dir so its refusal never lands in the live clearance queue. Clauses 3 and 8 live at their own components (RULE 1 and the ticket's proofs measuring their own component): cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_the_harbor_answers_no_clear.py and cairn/machines/ticket/proofs/test_a_passed_ticket_crosses_through_the_gates_door.py.
